title: Kubu language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Sumatra, Indonesia
extract: Kubu is a Malayic language spoken in the southern swamps of the island of Sumatra in Indonesia by the Kubu people, many of whom are nomadic. There is a degree of dialectal diversity.
